spec.rig: blender-bird/v1 (bird_rig.py), rigid; clips Idle, Walk, Fly

axes: metres; Blender Z up; origin bottom centre; front = Blender -Y; glTF +Y up; stock UE glTF Interchange maps UE = 100 * (x_b, -y_b, z_b) (UEB 48725), so the front lands on UE +Y; decided (buffffff 48769): no export rotation, face it with actor/component yaw -90 at placement (like the UE mannequin); assets whose UE attach code needs mesh +X forward get revisited one by one; L = Blender +X (the bird's own left)
bind: rigid per part (bind_mode rigid): every part 100% on its bone; beaks and wings never bend

unreal.type: skeletal mesh + anim sequences (Idle, Walk, Fly), root bone 'Root' on the ground
unreal.sockets: skeleton sockets from <asset>.sockets.json: SOCKET_LegBand on Leg_L
